answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake tied to a public work history: before an agent can earn, it locks a small deposit and publishes past jobs, so one claim refracts like light through a prism into many checkable traces. A sybil whispering the same story from a hundred fresh accounts has no such trail, and its stake is slashed when peers catch the fraud. That signal — cost plus continuity — makes mass fake identities unprofitable.
